publication_status: Not published by this retention step. CI checks passed; release acceptance and independent package audit are separate pending decisions. This observation is frozen.
findings: The shared Release gate reported 91 tests, executed 90, explicitly skipped one opt-in generator and failed none. All 14 CPR review controls executed.
The packaged application passed 87 native-window checks, 155 host controls and 91 checks through each production helper. All 16 CPR process gates passed.

All eight native workspace states preserved the same shared-session identity and had zero unnecessary vertical scrolling. Compact and Normal rows measured 44 and 68 DIP; the Normal 298-DIP content fit its measured viewport; dimensions are retained in the workspace records.

Hiding the left and mixer zones returned their space to the timeline. The splitter reached mixer heights 196 and 359 with a 220-DIP minimum arrangement; fader scales stayed aligned and keyboard focus was preserved.

The separate source-selection control copied the locked authored sidecars unchanged, added one empty track, observed a null event selection on that track, then selected the retained event through the source-list handler and observed expansion. The canonical one-track source fixture was reopened before attachment, export and its final screenshot.

Nine PNGs were retained: main arrangement, source, horizontal scroll, Normal and expanded workspace, two CPR review sizes, and two long-name top-row captures. Each actual dimension is recorded without assuming the wider request changed the hosted display.

The top rows measured contiguous heights 25, 30, 18 and 34 DIP, ending at workspace Y 107. Actual toolbar, status and event rectangles and text metrics passed the committed containment gates. Empty/source timings remained explicit dashes with editing disabled; ordinary zero retained its numeric value.

Authored long names exercised real text truncation and full-name tooltips. Four top-row selection contexts and both capture states preserved the shared-session state. Divider coverage and the pinned ruler corner were measured from the rendered application.

Independent PNG decoding reproduced both CPR alpha diagnostics: minimum alpha 254, 4979 pixels at alpha 254, and zero pixels below 254 in each image. All footer controls fit their respective client bounds.
The exact committed geometry, source-selection, musical-ruler and anchored-header receipt gates passed again during retention. This is receipt verification, not another native application execution.

The authored example, source-event PCM, preserved CPR/report, waveform and musical-ruler locks matched through the packaged helper and separate shared helper. App-local CLR/native and Swift modules were observed by the successful workflow.
The 1400-DIP outer-width request was constrained to 1100 DIP by the hosted display; wider_observed is false and both long-name captures are 1084 by 749. A genuinely wider desktop was not exercised.
No audio endpoint was available; no audio-device playback was measured. Package identity is from the CI receipt; independent ZIP audit and release acceptance remain separate.
package_identity_source: CI receipt; independent ZIP audit pending

waveform.oracle: Independent signed PCM16 extrema over exact source intervals

ruler.oracle: Authored constant 96 BPM, 4/4: quarter = 5/8 seconds; bar = 5/2 seconds

visual_evidence.manual_review: PNG structure, dimensions and CPR alpha distributions independently checked during retention. Candidate visual acceptance is recorded separately.

boundaries: All 55 raw artifacts are retained byte-exactly. Earlier failed native observations remain separate and unchanged.

These images render the client visual tree of the opened WPF application, excluding its native frame. File-picker and dirty-choice decisions were injected; native file dialogs and physical input were not tested.
The native authored review contains 15 items on one page. Separate host and Swift controls cover pagination and bounds; they do not establish native multi-page interaction.
The minimum-size error capture contains the observed 85-character message. Error scrolling was not exercised by this native run.

The source auto-expansion check uses a clearly recorded derived scratch fixture and a programmatic SelectionChanged event. It does not modify the frozen fixture or establish physical interaction with hidden content.
Authored fixture controls and scoped workspace geometry do not establish proprietary reference behavior, full CPR compatibility or complete Windows fidelity.
The requested wider window did not become wider on this runner. The retained wide-named image is a second constrained-size observation, not evidence of wider desktop behavior.

No ZIP was downloaded or published by this retention step. Independent package audit and visual/release acceptance belong to separate additive records; this frozen observation must not be rewritten to imply those later decisions.
